title: How did your cup turn out?
intro: Record a cup you actually brewed. Your result helps personalize your next recipe suggestions.

statuses.brewed_with_modifications: I changed the recipe or settings

actualHint: Starting values come from the recipe. Check them against what you actually used; leave time blank when unknown.
grind: Your intended grind change next time (optional)
confirmBrewed: I actually brewed this cup and checked the recorded amounts.
share: Share this attempt as community evidence
shareHint: Your account, recipe, result, modification status and time become visible. Detailed taste scores and your next-grind note stay private.
privacy: Private by default. Sharing is optional, and we never mark a self-report as device-verified.
savedPrivate: Only you can read this attempt. It can improve your own recommendations, not the community score.
savedShared: Your attempt can now contribute to community evidence. Repeat cups are not counted as additional distinct brewers.
unlinked: This quick-start cup has no linked recipe, so it will not be credited to a recipe or its community score.
signIn: Sign in with a permanent account
retryHint: The submitted values are kept unchanged for a safe retry. A retry will not create another cup.
skippedTime: You skipped a timer step. The simulated time is not recorded as your actual brew time; enter your measured time or leave it blank.
loadError: We could not load this recipe. No result has been saved.

errors.invalid: Check the amounts, select your result, and confirm that you brewed this cup.
errors.auth: A permanent signed-in account is required to save a brew result. Your answers remain here.
errors.unavailable: The recipe or saving service is unavailable. Nothing has been reported as saved; retry after it is restored.
errors.retry: The save could not be confirmed. Your answers are preserved; retry the same save safely.
errors.conflict: This save identifier was already used with different answers. No existing result was overwritten. Reload before recording another cup.
